name: legal-platform
description: پلتفرم حقوقی (Legal Platform) — self-hosted practice workspace for Iranian lawyers
author: Mohammad Ansari (https://ansariai.ir)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @legal-platform/domain -w @legal-platform/contracts -w @legal-platform/shared && npm run build -w @legal-platform/agent-civil-expert -w @legal-platform/agent-criminal-expert -w @legal-platform/agent-family-expert -w @legal-platform/agent-registration-expert -w @legal-platform/agent-international-expert -w @legal-platform/agent-legal-expert-base
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:agents && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
